name: sok-interrupt-watch-change
description: A status watch prints the value that status.get returns, then a status.changed whose value is larger than a pipe buffer. The watch waits in its write while the reader does not read; SIGTERM closes the connection, and the watch ends with status 0.
reason: The value must be larger than the pipe buffer of the test, and the signal ends the client, which the window check does not do.
